vuln_statements.explanation: This statement allocates memory using struct_size() with nregions as a multiplier. Without prior validation of nregions bounds, this could lead to integer overflow in the size calculation, resulting in undersized allocation and potential heap buffer overflow when writing to the regions array. The lack of bounds checking on nregions before use in struct_size() makes this the primary vulnerable statement.
